## Literal result and limits

Full negative answer to the literal 2007 Conjecture 32(a) and the catalog conjunction for problem **9700026 / AMR-096-0026**, rank 934. For every finite family of at least two distinct interior cities and every positive initial probability vector, **beta > 2 alpha gives uniform persistence**. The explicit asymmetric alpha=2, beta=8 instance has every weight in **[1/4096, 2047/2048] for all time**, contradicting the alpha>1 collapse alternative.

This does **not** settle collapse restricted to beta<2alpha, the critical case, convergence or uniqueness/initial-value independence of positive limits, or stochastic models with new cities. It does not refute the parameter-restricted 2012 paper. No novelty, human peer-review or formal-certification claim is made.

Two independent AI-assisted mathematical/source reviews accept the exact same author proof **without repair**. Each also supplies an independent local-Lipschitz and trajectory-uniqueness argument. Original author pending-review labels remain unchanged in the frozen inputs; the separate acceptance reports provide the later verdicts.

## Files and scope

- 40 added files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/9700026/`: authored proof/checkers, exact safe freezes and expanded members, independent audits and acceptances, public citations, public verification metadata, and a fail-closed replay wrapper.
- `unsolved_math_prioritization/QUEUE.md`: only rank 934's **Status** (`claimed_solved`), **Turns** (`2/5`) and prominently qualified **Findings** cells change. All unrelated bytes and existing links are preserved.
- No source PDFs, source text, dataset contents, private sources, personal data, or private coordination files are added. Draft only; no merge, release, DOI or outreach.

The unchanged historical sha:size prefix is literal existing QUEUE content. The complete base file was fetched as base64 at `5de48499b84f168099d0273a340f4976f841f691`: 393342 bytes, recomputed Git blob SHA `03f0ef6adc2b8d550f8b2b370f63689d72757553`. The historical embedded SHA is not represented as a fresh full-blob identity.

## Verification

Local preparation and a fresh download of the exact published commit each passed **56 normal/optimized/isolated/relocated executions** and **106 adversarial rejection tests**. These include complete corpus and both primary-PDF pin replays, all public-member mutations, malformed/missing/forged manifests, extra files, symlinks, and mutations of each complete corpus/PDF input. Known-good wrapper code was used to test mutations of the wrapper itself.

All **41 remote files / 670367 aggregate bytes** were read back from the exact commit and matched their local bytes, SHA-256 hashes and Git blob identifiers. Both ZIP inventories, all expanded members and both acceptance records were verified. All positive local/remote replay outputs match. A source-free wrapper run explicitly reports the external corpus/PDF checks as `NOT_RUN`; those inputs must be supplied separately for full provenance replay. Hashes and finite checks do not certify the analytic proof or replace mathematical/source review.

The externally pinned `PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json` is **6446 bytes**, SHA-256:

`379efdd8506bb5f28c80ece66fc5b9e130a9668c5605343443cb811b84a23081`

From the attempt directory:

```sh
python -I -B verify_publication.py --manifest-sha256 379efdd8506bb5f28c80ece66fc5b9e130a9668c5605343443cb811b84a23081
python -I -B -O verify_publication.py --manifest-sha256 379efdd8506bb5f28c80ece66fc5b9e130a9668c5605343443cb811b84a23081
```

For the full provenance replay, add `--corpus CORPUS_DIRECTORY --sources PDF_DIRECTORY` as documented in the README. The published checks are local execution evidence; GitHub CI status must be read separately and zero checks must not be called passing CI.
